title: ListedTranscript
description: One conversation of the history, as a listing shows it: the conversation, where it ran, and what it is doing now.

sessionId.description: The id of the conversation alone, for the published app of the previous protocol — gone when its window closes (plan 28, D-08).

summary.description: What the conversation is about, as the engine summarises it.

origin.description: `ours` — opened here, by the caller — or `external`: begun elsewhere on the machine.

gitBranch.description: The branch it ran on, when the engine recorded one.

createdAt.description: When it began, ISO 8601, when the engine recorded it.

lastModified.description: When it was last written, ISO 8601.

activity.description: `liveHere` · `activeElsewhere` · `idle` — the last an estimate, said to be one.

liveSessionId.description: The caller's live session that holds it, when it is `liveHere`.

writtenAgoSeconds.description: How long ago it was last written, in whole seconds.
